prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic four-panel lifestyle grid collage of an approved adult blonde woman posing casually in a modern minimalist kitchen.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult blonde woman with long soft waves and a confident friendly relaxed expression. She wears a white cropped short-sleeve top and mint-green high-waisted fitted shorts consistently across all panels.
prompt.composition_elements: Four-panel grid with leaning-forward smile at a kitchen counter, side profile, back-facing look over shoulder, and front-facing hands-on-hips pose. Use light stone countertop, neutral cabinetry, and clean contemporary layout.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm overhead indoor light, flattering but natural, clean contemporary fitness-lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution 4:5 grid collage, eye-level 35mm perspective, mid-body to upper-leg framing, sharp subject with lightly softened background, crisp realistic texture.

Keep her white cropped short-sleeve top and mint-green high-waisted fitted shorts consistent across all panels. Show a leaning-forward smile at the counter, side profile, back-facing look over shoulder, and front-facing hands-on-hips pose.
